claims: The Academy Awards are presented by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
Best Picture is an Academy Awards category.
Actor is an Academy Awards category.
Director is an Academy Awards category.
Academy Awards categories are voted on by film industry professionals.
The Academy Awards trophy is nicknamed "Oscar".
The Academy Awards trophy is a 13.5-inch tall gold-plated bronze statue.
The Academy Awards trophy represents a knight on a film reel.
The first Academy Awards were held in 1929.
Academy Awards winners are chosen by over 10,000 Academy members.
Academy members are peers working within the film industry.
The 98th Academy Awards took place in March 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards celebrated films from the previous year.
